description: CrunchJunkie brings your AI-search visibility and marketing reports into ChatGPT. Ask how often AI assistants and AI search engines name your brand or your clients, which sources they cite, how you compare with competitors, and how your search rankings, site audit and ad performance moved. Answers come straight from your live CrunchJunkie account, with the time window and sample size behind every figure. By default the connection only reads data in your own workspace. A workspace owner can allow changes (for example creating a report, adding tracked keywords or starting a scan); each change is then shown as a preview first and runs only after you confirm it. Actions that start paid work, such as AI scans, stay off unless the owner allows them separately. Requires a CrunchJunkie account.
